actionLog: A concurrent routine run raced on this same item and produced three PRs; #12 is the one that correctly and completely covers this request — it lets you edit a Jynx-feedback comment's own text (via the admin's Jynx tab) and adds a grantable "Jynx commenter" permission tier so an admin can let a regular dev user leave Jynx-meta feedback too, while keeping viewing/resolving/exporting the full Jynx queue admin-only exactly as asked. #9 attempted the same permission tier but accidentally also exposed the full admin feedback queue to any Jynx commenter (not just their own entries) and was closed in #12's favor. #7 (still open, separate PR) adds edit-your-own-text for regular QA-annotation comments — a related but distinct feature, not this note's own edit capability.

replies.text: Partial progress: every dev user now has their own comments view (the sidebar, with an Open/Done split and a Just me filter), can jump to a comment's location, and can reply to any comment thread. Editing your own comment text, and the separate 'jynx commenter' permission tier for regular dev users, are still open.
